title: The Gibeonites Avenged

questions.question: Why was there a famine for three years?
options: Because of Saul and his bloodthirsty house
questions.correctAnswer: Because of Saul and his bloodthirsty house
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:1 (ESV): "...It is for Saul and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death."

questions.question: What did the Gibeonites demand for atonement?
options: Seven of Saul's sons to be hanged
questions.correctAnswer: Seven of Saul's sons to be hanged
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:6 (ESV): "let seven men of his sons be given to us, so that we may hang them before the LORD..."

questions.question: Who did David spare from the Gibeonites?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:7 (ESV): "But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Saul's son Jonathan, because of the oath of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who protected the bodies of the hanged men from birds and beasts?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:10 (ESV): "Then Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth... and she did not allow the birds of the air to come upon them..."

questions.question: Who was the giant with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot?
options: (Unnamed in text, a descendant of the giants)
questions.correctAnswer: (Unnamed in text, a descendant of the giants)
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:20 (ESV): "And there was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on each hand, and six toes on each foot..."

questions.question: Who killed the giant Ishbi-benob who meant to kill David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:17 (ESV): "But Abishai the son of Zeruiah came to his aid and attacked the Philistine and killed him."

questions.question: What did David's men swear to him after the near-death experience with the giant?
options: You shall no longer go out with us to battle
questions.correctAnswer: You shall no longer go out with us to battle
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:17 (ESV): "...You shall no longer go out with us to battle, lest you quench the lamp of Israel."

questions.question: Whose bones did David gather to bury?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:12-13 (ESV): "...David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of his son Jonathan..."

questions.question: Where were the bones of Saul and Jonathan buried?
options: In the country of Benjamin at Zela
questions.correctAnswer: In the country of Benjamin at Zela
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:14 (ESV): "And they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the land of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish..."

questions.question: Who killed Goliath the Gittite (according to 2 Samuel 21:19)?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:19 (ESV): "...Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, the Bethlehemite, struck down Goliath the Gittite..." (Note: Harmonized generally as "brother of Goliath" in Chronicles, but text says Goliath here).

questions.question: Who were the two sons of Rizpah handed over?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:8 (ESV): "The king took the two sons of Rizpah... Armoni and Mephibosheth..."

questions.question: Who were the five sons handed over sons of?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:8 (ESV): "...and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul..." (ESV corrects to Merab, Hebrew says Michal but she had no children).

questions.question: In which town were the men hanged?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:6 (ESV): "...so that we may hang them before the LORD at Gibeah of Saul..."

questions.question: Who killed Saph, one of the descendants of the giants?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:18 (ESV): "...then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Saph..."

questions.question: Who killed the giant with 24 digits?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 21:21 (ESV): "...Jonathan the son of Shimei, David's brother, struck him down."

key_verse_text: And they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the land of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father. And they did all that the king commanded. And after that God responded to the plea for the land. (ESV)
